added_failures_note: baseline_suite (179f35c39, logs/base-population.log) exit 1 with 1 failure id, tests/test_producer_reads_only_what_changed.py::test_bytes_parsed_equals_bytes_appended_and_unchanged_polls_parse_nothing; after_suite (ed6aa72b2, logs/head-population-final.log) exit 1 with 1 failure id, tests/test_external_wait.py::test_the_sweep_resumes_only_after_the_condition_terminates; the set difference is therefore 1. That id is a parallel-execution flake rather than a regression: all 33 tests of the three flake-prone files pass serially at head (logs/head-suspect-files-final.log, 33 passed, EXIT=0), and an earlier head arm at 0f9c6dc56 was fully green at -n 8 (1054 passed, EXIT=0) though its log path was later reused for the ed6aa72b2 arm so no on-disk log now carries it.

findings.text: 'except Exception: return' makes a lost announcement completely silent - no line to the producer's own log and no counter - so the one case this guard exists for, a stream the release could not write, is the case a later reader has no way to find; the release prints its verdict to stdout at :460, so one line there or in the producer log keeps the never-blocks-the-release intent without the blindness.

the Gate paragraph calls the head-final failure 'the same flake that fails at base - test_external_wait.py::test_the_sweep_resumes_only_after_the_condition_terminates', but the base arm's sole failure is test_producer_reads_only_what_changed.py::test_bytes_parsed_equals_bytes_appended_and_unchanged_polls_parse_nothing, so the two logs carry different ids and a reader reconciling them finds the identity claim contradicted; it is the same class of parallel flake, not the same id.

the tests: line carries an unsubstituted $W twice ('PYTHONPATH=$W' and '(cwd $W)'), so the gate receipt promotion fills from this line cannot be replayed as written; the after_suite command and every log's own '# command:' header do carry the resolved absolute paths, which is why this does not hold the node.

the manifest and the fragment both cite a green head arm at 0f9c6dc56 (1054 passed, EXIT=0, 479.5 s) but no log on disk records that revision - this path's own header reads ed6aa72b2, so it was reused for the later arm and the cited green figure survives only in the run's transcript; the flake attribution still stands on logs/head-suspect-files-final.log (33 passed serially), but the figure itself cannot be reconciled from the recorded artefacts.
